turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've been trying to activate my new card in the app for an hour and it keeps failing. I'm getting really annoyed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry about that. The activation failed because the card hadn't been marked as delivered on our side. I've updated that, so please try again now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, I just tried again and the app says the card is active.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, the activation went through on our side as well, and the card is ready for payments.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Brilliant, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, I'm really happy it's sorted!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, enjoy using your new card.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My transfer to my landlord was declined again today and nobody can tell me why. This is unacceptable.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. The payment was stopped by an automated security check, and the review team has to clear it before it can go through.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's what I was told yesterday. I want to speak to a supervisor right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've raised an escalation to a supervisor. They will contact you within two working days; I can't release the transfer myself.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Two more days? My rent is already late and I'm furious that this still isn't fixed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. The case is marked urgent and the supervisor will review it.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello. I'm moving to Portugal next month. Can I keep using my account as a resident there?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. When will I get an answer?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Compliance usually replies within five working days, and we will send the answer to the email address on your account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. I'll wait for the email then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted. The request stays open and you'll hear from us once compliance has confirmed.
